GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

5. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   D. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   C. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   D. Treat Trade as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   B. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   D. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   D. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

15. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   B. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   C. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   B. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   D. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Lakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Underground Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Karst Scenery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Glaciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
